caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a decorative bonnet. The bonnet is predominantly a mix of muted green, purple, and brown hues, with intricate patterns and textures suggesting layers of fabric, lace, and ribbon. A prominent highlight is the yellowish-beige lattice structure at the front, resembling a net or woven pattern. The edge of the bonnet is lined with small, multicolored leaves or floral decorations, blending shades of green, pink, and yellow. At the top right of the bonnet, there is a large black lacy bow or frill, and a separate, blue-handled, spotted ribbon that curls outward. The bonnet has two long, dark ribbons that hang down, tied in a bow at the bottom center. The background is a plain, light beige, and the artist's name, "FRANCES L.AMA DURAND," is visible at the lower right corner.
title: Bonnet
